title: Соединение
semantics: Combine exactly two tables by row position: input 0 is main, input 1 is attached; output 0 is a table. Never match keys or sort rows. Preserve both inputs' fields and scalar types, including same-name fields. Read native generated names before mapping the output. row_count minimum/maximum chooses the shorter/longer length; input uses determining_input main/attached. padding null/repeat/last fills absent rows with NULL, cycles the whole shorter table, or repeats its final row. An empty table has no row to repeat: its fields remain NULL. Preserve source NULL, empty string, zero and false. Execute recomputes current inputs without training; no saved-model apply or variables. Existing parameters:{} preserves supported settings. New nodes require both table connections and explicit row_count/padding. More tables and variable ports are unsupported.

parameter_schema.description: Proposed stage-1 schema, not registered. New nodes require col_union with row_count and padding; existing omission preserves settings. Reject unsupported saved configurations before mutation.

col_union.description: Positional table settings. Existing fields form a patch; omitted fields retain their saved supported values.

row_count.description: Output length: min or max of the two input row counts; input uses determining_input. No key matching.

padding.description: Absent row: NULL cells, cyclic repetition of the entire input, or repetition of its last row. An empty input always contributes NULL cells.

determining_input.description: Required with row_count=input: main=input 0, attached=input 1. Reject with minimum/maximum; never identify the source by label.
